key_decisions: Gear policy tier 3 CUT. The recipe writes the character only; a user who wants no weapons edits the description. Forced by evidence, not preference - v4 returned 'with a gunbelt slung low across his hips' for 'a gunslinger, no weapons', and a positively-phrased item is invisible to any scrub. Rejected on the way: a StringContains-triggered weapon-clause regex, because the vocabulary is open-ended and a wordlist that catches 'bandolier' also deletes the satchel the user wanted.

Prompt enhancement is its own workflow, and it is UNIVERSAL. The recipe injects into Input_System_Prompt, and BOTH scrub patterns inject too (Input_Scrub_Negation.regex_pattern, Input_Tidy.regex_pattern) so a universal workflow cannot silently mangle another flow's output; a flow wanting no scrub injects a pattern that cannot match, (?!x)x. Consequence: the recipe is APP payload now, not graph payload - prompts.md's opening claim was corrected.

No enhance toggle anywhere. The button enhances, the result lands in the prompt box, the sheet takes the box verbatim - so double-enhancing is impossible rather than guarded against. The MpiIfElse was deleted, not flipped.

The user LoRA rack STAYS (reversing the earlier 'a Flow runs clean' line). A character LoRA carries identity while the sheet carries layout, and the user still describes wardrobe, hair and face on top. flow_ltx_extend and flow_ltx_foley already ship the same six-slot rack and comfyController routes Input_Lora_N through its MPI-219 branch, so no new machinery.

Never put a readable example inside a system prompt for this 4B. v1's parenthetical 'a weathered Plains chief in his late sixties, ...' came back verbatim as the answer for two unrelated inputs. Show a slot template instead.
constraints: STRIPPING A GRAPH BY GROUP BOX FAILS SILENTLY HERE. The Edit group BUILDS the shared conditioning (CLIPTextEncode -> ToBasicPipe -> Set_Models, which FromBasicPipe in the KEPT Generation group reads) and the Images group holds Input_Width/Input_Height. SetNode/GetNode link by NAME, so every link still resolves on a decapitated graph and 'all links resolve: true' proves nothing. Check Get/Set pairing and trace orphan Gets to their CONSUMERS.
comfy_workflows/raw/ is USER-OWNED. Fabio authors there. Two edits were made this session and BOTH were explicitly authorised by him first - do not treat that as standing permission.
GPU: Fabio asked for no GPU run without his say-so, even though the bench is idle. Text-only enhancer runs are seconds on the 4B but still ask.

TextGenerate.sampling_mode is a COMFY_DYNAMICCOMBO_V3 - its sub-inputs are FLAT keys prefixed with the parent id ('sampling_mode.temperature'), not a nested object. Getting it wrong returns required_input_missing for every sub-input at once, which reads like a broken node.
